**1823** ([MDCCCXXIII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_numerals "Roman numerals")) was a [common year starting on Wednesday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Wednesday "Common year starting on Wednesday") of the [Gregorian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar "Gregorian calendar")and a [common year starting on Monday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Monday "Common year starting on Monday") of the [Julian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_calendar "Julian calendar"), the 1823rd year of the [Common Era](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Era "Common Era") (CE) and _[Anno Domini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anno\_Domini "Anno Domini")_ (AD) designations, the 823rd year of the [2nd millennium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2nd_millennium "2nd millennium"), the 23rd year of the [19th century](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/19th_century "19th century"), and the 4th year of the [1820s](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1820s "1820s") decade. As of the start of 1823, the Gregorian calendar was 12 days ahead of the Julian calendar, which remained in localized use until 1923.

### January–March

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: January–March")]

[![Image 4](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ad/To_James_Weddell%2C_Esqr_R.N_-_the_brig_Jane_and_cutter_Beaufoy_on_20th_February_1823%2C_bearing_up_in_74o_15%27_%28Being_the_highest_Southern_Latitude_ever_reached%29_RMG_PY8482_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-thumbnail.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:To_James_Weddell,_Esqr_R.N_-_the_brig_Jane_and_cutter_Beaufoy_on_20th_February_1823,_bearing_up_in_74o_15'_(Being_the_highest_Southern_Latitude_ever_reached)_RMG_PY8482_(cropped).jpg)

[February 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_20 "February 20"): [James Weddell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Weddell "James Weddell")'s _Jane_ and _Beaufoy_ at their furthest south.

*   [January 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_22 "January 22") – By secret treaty signed at the [Congress of Verona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congress_of_Verona#Spanish_Question "Congress of Verona"), the [Quintuple Alliance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quintuple_Alliance "Quintuple Alliance") gives France a mandate to invade [Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain "Spain") for the purpose of restoring [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII_of_Spain "Ferdinand VII of Spain") (who has been captured by armed revolutionary liberals) as absolute monarch of the country.
*   [January 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_23 "January 23") – In Paviland Cave on the [Gower Peninsula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gower_Peninsula "Gower Peninsula") of Wales, [William Buckland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Buckland "William Buckland") inspects the "[Red Lady of Paviland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Lady_of_Paviland "Red Lady of Paviland")", the first identification of a prehistoric (male) human burial (although Buckland dates it as Roman).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-1)
*   [February 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_3 "February 3")
    *   Jackson Male Academy, precursor of [Union University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Union_University "Union University"), opens in Alabama.
    *   [Gioachino Rossini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gioachino_Rossini "Gioachino Rossini")'s opera _[Semiramide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semiramide "Semiramide")_ is first performed, at _[La Fenice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La\_Fenice "La Fenice")_ in Venice.

*   [February 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_10 "February 10") – The first worldwide carnival parade takes place in [Cologne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cologne "Cologne"), [Prussia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Prussia "Kingdom of Prussia").
*   [February 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_11 "February 11") – [Carnival tragedy of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carnival_tragedy_of_1823 "Carnival tragedy of 1823"): About 110 boys are killed during a stampede at the [Convent of the Minori Osservanti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franciscan_Church_of_St_Mary_of_Jesus "Franciscan Church of St Mary of Jesus") in [Valletta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valletta "Valletta"), [Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crown_Colony_of_Malta "Crown Colony of Malta").
*   [February 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_15 "February 15") (approx.) – The first officially recognised [gold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold "Gold") is found in [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia "Australia"), by surveyor James McBrien at [Fish River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fish_River_(Oberon) "Fish River (Oberon)"), near [Bathurst, New South Wales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bathurst,_New_South_Wales "Bathurst, New South Wales"), predating the [Australian gold rushes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_gold_rushes "Australian gold rushes").
*   [February 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_20 "February 20") – Explorer [James Weddell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Weddell "James Weddell")'s expedition to Antarctica reaches [latitude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude "Latitude") 74°15'S and [longitude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Longitude "Longitude") 34°16'45"W: the [southernmost position](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Farthest_South "Farthest South") any ship has reached at this time.
*   [February 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_28 "February 28") – [José de la Riva Agüero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Riva_Ag%C3%BCero "José de la Riva Agüero") is sworn as the first [president of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Peru "President of Peru") following a coup against the government of [José de la Mar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Mar "José de la Mar"). He only rules 115 days.
*   [March 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_15 "March 15") – Sailor [Benjamin Morrell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benjamin_Morrell "Benjamin Morrell")[erroneously reports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantom_island "Phantom island") the existence of the island of [New South Greenland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_South_Greenland "New South Greenland") near [Antarctica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antarctica "Antarctica").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-2)
*   [March 19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_19 "March 19") – Emperor [Agustín de Iturbide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agust%C3%ADn_de_Iturbide "Agustín de Iturbide") of Mexico abdicates, thus ending the short-lived [First Mexican Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Mexican_Empire "First Mexican Empire").

### April–June

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: April–June")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d0/Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d%27Angoul%C3%AAme%2C_31_aout_1823_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d%27Angoul%C3%AAme%2C_31_aout_1823_%28cropped%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d'Angoul%C3%AAme,_31_aout_1823_(cropped).jpg)

[April 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_7 "April 7"): The "[Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis")", a French infantry force, begin an attack on Spain that lasts until November.

*   [April 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_7 "April 7") – French forces, the "[Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis")", cross the Spanish border at the [Bidasoa River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bidasoa_River "Bidasoa River").
*   [April 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_10 "April 10") – [Siege of Pamplona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Pamplona_(1823) "Siege of Pamplona (1823)") begins in [Navarre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navarre "Navarre") as French troops besiege the city's garrison.
*   [April 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_13 "April 13") – [Franz Liszt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franz_Liszt "Franz Liszt"), 11, gives a concert in Vienna, after which he is personally congratulated by [Ludwig van Beethoven](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ludwig_van_Beethoven "Ludwig van Beethoven").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-3)
*   [May 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_5 "May 5") – Emperor [Pedro I of Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_I_of_Brazil "Pedro I of Brazil") inaugurates [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil "Brazil")'s first _Assembleia Geral_, with 50 Senators and 102 Deputies.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-4)
*   [May 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_7 "May 7") – [Mikhail Semyonovich Vorontsov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikhail_Semyonovich_Vorontsov "Mikhail Semyonovich Vorontsov") is appointed as [Governor-General](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor-General "Governor-General") of [Novorossiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Novorossiya "Novorossiya") (New Russia), the portion of [Russian Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_Empire "Russian Empire") bordering the Black Sea (in modern days it constitutes southern regions of [Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine")).[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-5)
*   [May 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_9 "May 9") – Russian author [Alexander Pushkin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_Pushkin "Alexander Pushkin") begins work on his verse novel _[Eugene Onegin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugene\_Onegin "Eugene Onegin")_.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-6)
*   [May 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_23 "May 23")
    *   The [rebel Spanish government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trienio_Liberal "Trienio Liberal") withdraws from [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid") to [Seville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seville "Seville") following the French advance.

*   [May 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_25 "May 25")
    *   The [Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), commander of the invading French forces, establishes a regency in [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid") on behalf of [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII "Ferdinand VII") who remains a captive of the Spanish government.
    *   The [Catholic Association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_Association "Catholic Association"), a campaign for [Catholic emancipation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_emancipation "Catholic emancipation") within the United Kingdom, begins in Ireland at a meeting of 13 people at a bookseller's house on [Capel Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capel_Street "Capel Street") in [Dublin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dublin "Dublin").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-7)

*   [June 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_5 "June 5") – [Raffles Institution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raffles_Institution "Raffles Institution") is established (as the Singapore Institution) by the founder of [Singapore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore "Singapore"), Sir [Stamford Raffles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stamford_Raffles "Stamford Raffles").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-8)
*   [June 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_23 "June 23") – Peruvian president [José de la Riva Agüero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Riva_Ag%C3%BCero "José de la Riva Agüero") is [impeached](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeachment "Impeachment") by Congress. He rebels and establishes a short-lived rival government in [Trujillo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trujillo,_Peru "Trujillo, Peru").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-9)

### July–September

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: July–September")]

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/50/Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg/250px-Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg)

[August 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_18 "August 18"): The [Demerara rebellion of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara_rebellion_of_1823 "Demerara rebellion of 1823") is started by 10,000 black slaves in British Guiana.

*   [July 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_1 "July 1") – The [Congress of Central America](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Republic_of_Central_America "Federal Republic of Central America") declares absolute independence from Spain, Mexico and any other foreign nation, including North America, and a republican system of government is established.
*   [July 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_4 "July 4") – [Royal assent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_assent "Royal assent") is given to several significant [Acts of Parliament in the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acts_of_Parliament_in_the_United_Kingdom "Acts of Parliament in the United Kingdom"), after the [Home Secretary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Home_Secretary "Home Secretary") (and future Prime Minister) [Robert Peel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Peel "Robert Peel") had worked to get approval by Parliament. Approved are the [Judgment of Death Act 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judgment_of_Death_Act_1823 "Judgment of Death Act 1823"), effectively abolishing the [death penalty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_penalty "Death penalty") for over 100 offences and;[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10) allowing judges to commute sentences for capital offences (other than murder or treason) to imprisonment or [transportation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penal_transportation "Penal transportation").;[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-11) the Transportation Act allowing convicts transported to the colonies to be employed on public works.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10) On July 10, the [Gaols Act 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaols_Act_1823 "Gaols Act 1823") is given assent, beginning the process of prison reform based on the campaign of [Elizabeth Fry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_Fry "Elizabeth Fry").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10)
*   [July 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_15 "July 15") – The [Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basilica_of_Saint_Paul_Outside_the_Walls "Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls") in Rome is almost completely destroyed by fire.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Fires-12)
*   [July 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_16 "July 16") – [José Bernardo de Tagle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_Bernardo_de_Tagle_y_Portocarrero,_4th_Marquess_of_Torre_Tagle "José Bernardo de Tagle y Portocarrero, 4th Marquess of Torre Tagle") elected as the second [president of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Peru "President of Peru") by the Peruvian Congress.
*   [July 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_28 "July 28") – The first theatrical adaptation of the _[Frankenstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankenstein "Frankenstein")_ story, _[Presumption; or, the Fate of Frankenstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presumption;\_or,\_the\_Fate\_of\_Frankenstein "Presumption; or, the Fate of Frankenstein")_, opens at the [Royal Opera House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Opera_House "Royal Opera House"), [Covent Garden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Covent_Garden "Covent Garden") in London. On August 29, [Mary Shelley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Shelley "Mary Shelley") attends a performance, the only version of her novel she will ever see.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-13)
*   [August 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_1 "August 1") – [William Pitt Amherst](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Amherst,_1st_Earl_Amherst "William Amherst, 1st Earl Amherst") arrives in [Calcutta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calcutta "Calcutta") with Lady Amherst to become the new [Governor-General of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor-General_of_India "Governor-General of India").[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-14)
*   [August 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_4 "August 4") – [Felipe Enrique Neri, Baron de Bastrop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Felipe_Enrique_Neri,_Baron_de_Bastrop "Felipe Enrique Neri, Baron de Bastrop"), the Mexican government administrator in charge of Anglo-American immigration into Mexico's state of [Coahuila y Tejas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coahuila_y_Tejas "Coahuila y Tejas"), allows [Stephen F. Austin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_F._Austin "Stephen F. Austin") to put together an 11-man police force, that will later be expanded to become the [Texas Ranger Division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas_Ranger_Division "Texas Ranger Division").[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-15)
*   [August 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_5 "August 5") – The [Royal Hibernian Academy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Hibernian_Academy "Royal Hibernian Academy") is founded in [Dublin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dublin "Dublin").[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-16)
*   [August 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_16 "August 16") – Tsar [Alexander I of Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_I_of_Russia "Alexander I of Russia") draws up a secret "manifesto", designating his second younger brother [Nikolai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicholas_I_of_Russia "Nicholas I of Russia") to succeed him, bypassing Nikolai's older brother, [Grand Duke Konstantin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Duke_Konstantin_Pavlovich_of_Russia "Grand Duke Konstantin Pavlovich of Russia"). The existence of the manifesto is revealed on Alexander's death in 1825.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-17)
*   [August 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_18 "August 18") – [Demerara rebellion of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara_rebellion_of_1823 "Demerara rebellion of 1823"): In the British colony of [Demerara-Essequibo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara-Essequibo "Demerara-Essequibo") (modern-day Guyana in South America), an insurrection of 10,000 black slaves begins; it is suppressed after three days, but hundreds of suspects are executed in the reprisals that follow.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-18)
*   [August 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_20 "August 20") – [Pope Pius VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Pius_VII "Pope Pius VII") dies after a reign of more than 23 years that began on March 14, 1800; he is remembered for crowning [Napoleon Bonaparte](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napoleon_Bonaparte "Napoleon Bonaparte") as [Emperor of France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_of_France "Emperor of France").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Coulombe-19)
*   [August 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_24 "August 24") – [Hugh Glass](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugh_Glass "Hugh Glass") gets mauled by a sow grizzly while on a fur trapping expedition in the Missouri Territory and has to crawl 200 miles for help.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-20)
*   [August 31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_31 "August 31") – [Battle of Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero "Battle of Trocadero"): French infantry of the "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis" capture the fort of Trocadero and turn its guns on [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz").
*   [September 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_10 "September 10") – [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar") is named [dictator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dictator "Dictator") of [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru").
*   [September 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_17 "September 17") – [Pamplona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pamplona "Pamplona") surrenders to French forces after a five-month siege.
*   [September 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_22 "September 22") – [Joseph Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Smith "Joseph Smith") first goes to the place near [Manchester, New York](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchester,_New_York "Manchester, New York"), where the [golden plates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_plates "Golden plates") are stored, having been directed there by God through an angel (according to what he writes in 1838).
*   [September 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_23 "September 23") – [First Anglo-Burmese War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Anglo-Burmese_War "First Anglo-Burmese War"): [Burmese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burma "Burma") forces attack the British on Shapura, an island close to [Chittagong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chittagong "Chittagong").
*   [September 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_28 "September 28") – Roman Catholic Cardinal Annibale della Genga is elected [Pope Leo XII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Leo_XII "Pope Leo XII").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Coulombe-19)
*   [September 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_30 "September 30") – [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz") surrenders to the French and [Ferdinand VII of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII_of_Spain "Ferdinand VII of Spain") is restored to his throne, immediately repealing the liberal [Spanish Constitution of 1812](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Constitution_of_1812 "Spanish Constitution of 1812"). Despite French advice, he begins an era of repression against his opponents known as the [Ominous Decade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ominous_Decade "Ominous Decade").

### October–December

[December 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_2 "December 2"): The [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") is introduced by U.S. President [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe").

*   [October 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_5 "October 5") – _[The Lancet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Lancet "The Lancet")_ medical journal is founded by [Thomas Wakley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Wakley "Thomas Wakley") in London.
*   [October 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_22 "October 22") – [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar") writes to Paraguayan dictator [José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_Gaspar_Rodr%C3%ADguez_de_Francia "José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia") to release his friend the explorer [Aimé Bonpland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aim%C3%A9_Bonpland "Aimé Bonpland") under threat of invasion. Rodríguez never responds to the letter.
*   [November 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_3 "November 3") – An explosion at the Rainton Colliery Company's Plain Pit mine at [Chilton Moor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilton_Moor "Chilton Moor") in the north-east of England, kills at least 57 coal miners.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-21)
*   [November 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_7 "November 7") – General [Rafael del Riego](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_del_Riego "Rafael del Riego") is executed in Madrid for [high treason](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_treason "High treason").
*   [November 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_12 "November 12") – The first [Constitution of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution_of_Peru_(1823) "Constitution of Peru (1823)") is proclaimed, albeit it is almost immediately annulled by [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar").
*   [November](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November "November") – According to tradition, [William Webb Ellis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Webb_Ellis "William Webb Ellis") invents the sport of [rugby football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rugby_football "Rugby football") at [Rugby School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rugby_School "Rugby School") in England.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10)
*   [December 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_2 "December 2") – [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe") first introduces the [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") in the [State of the Union address](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_of_the_Union_address "State of the Union address"), declaring that any European attempts to recolonize the Americas would be considered a hostile act towards the United States.

**1823** ([MDCCCXXIII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_numerals "Roman numerals")) was a [common year starting on Wednesday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Wednesday "Common year starting on Wednesday") of the [Gregorian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar "Gregorian calendar")and a [common year starting on Monday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Monday "Common year starting on Monday") of the [Julian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_calendar "Julian calendar"), the 1823rd year of the [Common Era](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Era "Common Era") (CE) and _[Anno Domini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anno\_Domini "Anno Domini")_ (AD) designations, the 823rd year of the [2nd millennium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2nd_millennium "2nd millennium"), the 23rd year of the [19th century](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/19th_century "19th century"), and the 4th year of the [1820s](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1820s "1820s") decade. As of the start of 1823, the Gregorian calendar was 12 days ahead of the Julian calendar, which remained in localized use until 1923.

## Events

### January–March

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: January–March")]

[![Image 4](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ad/To_James_Weddell%2C_Esqr_R.N_-_the_brig_Jane_and_cutter_Beaufoy_on_20th_February_1823%2C_bearing_up_in_74o_15%27_%28Being_the_highest_Southern_Latitude_ever_reached%29_RMG_PY8482_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-thumbnail.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:To_James_Weddell,_Esqr_R.N_-_the_brig_Jane_and_cutter_Beaufoy_on_20th_February_1823,_bearing_up_in_74o_15'_(Being_the_highest_Southern_Latitude_ever_reached)_RMG_PY8482_(cropped).jpg)

[February 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_20 "February 20"): [James Weddell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Weddell "James Weddell")'s _Jane_ and _Beaufoy_ at their furthest south.

*   [January 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_22 "January 22") – By secret treaty signed at the [Congress of Verona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congress_of_Verona#Spanish_Question "Congress of Verona"), the [Quintuple Alliance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quintuple_Alliance "Quintuple Alliance") gives France a mandate to invade [Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain "Spain") for the purpose of restoring [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII_of_Spain "Ferdinand VII of Spain") (who has been captured by armed revolutionary liberals) as absolute monarch of the country.
*   [January 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_23 "January 23") – In Paviland Cave on the [Gower Peninsula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gower_Peninsula "Gower Peninsula") of Wales, [William Buckland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Buckland "William Buckland") inspects the "[Red Lady of Paviland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Lady_of_Paviland "Red Lady of Paviland")", the first identification of a prehistoric (male) human burial (although Buckland dates it as Roman).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-1)
*   [February 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_3 "February 3")
    *   Jackson Male Academy, precursor of [Union University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Union_University "Union University"), opens in Alabama.
    *   [Gioachino Rossini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gioachino_Rossini "Gioachino Rossini")'s opera _[Semiramide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semiramide "Semiramide")_ is first performed, at _[La Fenice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La\_Fenice "La Fenice")_ in Venice.

*   [February 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_10 "February 10") – The first worldwide carnival parade takes place in [Cologne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cologne "Cologne"), [Prussia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Prussia "Kingdom of Prussia").
*   [February 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_11 "February 11") – [Carnival tragedy of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carnival_tragedy_of_1823 "Carnival tragedy of 1823"): About 110 boys are killed during a stampede at the [Convent of the Minori Osservanti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franciscan_Church_of_St_Mary_of_Jesus "Franciscan Church of St Mary of Jesus") in [Valletta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valletta "Valletta"), [Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crown_Colony_of_Malta "Crown Colony of Malta").
*   [February 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_15 "February 15") (approx.) – The first officially recognised [gold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold "Gold") is found in [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia "Australia"), by surveyor James McBrien at [Fish River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fish_River_(Oberon) "Fish River (Oberon)"), near [Bathurst, New South Wales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bathurst,_New_South_Wales "Bathurst, New South Wales"), predating the [Australian gold rushes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_gold_rushes "Australian gold rushes").
*   [February 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_20 "February 20") – Explorer [James Weddell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Weddell "James Weddell")'s expedition to Antarctica reaches [latitude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude "Latitude") 74°15'S and [longitude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Longitude "Longitude") 34°16'45"W: the [southernmost position](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Farthest_South "Farthest South") any ship has reached at this time.
*   [February 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_28 "February 28") – [José de la Riva Agüero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Riva_Ag%C3%BCero "José de la Riva Agüero") is sworn as the first [president of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Peru "President of Peru") following a coup against the government of [José de la Mar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Mar "José de la Mar"). He only rules 115 days.
*   [March 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_15 "March 15") – Sailor [Benjamin Morrell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benjamin_Morrell "Benjamin Morrell")[erroneously reports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantom_island "Phantom island") the existence of the island of [New South Greenland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_South_Greenland "New South Greenland") near [Antarctica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antarctica "Antarctica").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-2)
*   [March 19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_19 "March 19") – Emperor [Agustín de Iturbide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agust%C3%ADn_de_Iturbide "Agustín de Iturbide") of Mexico abdicates, thus ending the short-lived [First Mexican Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Mexican_Empire "First Mexican Empire").

### April–June

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: April–June")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d0/Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d%27Angoul%C3%AAme%2C_31_aout_1823_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d%27Angoul%C3%AAme%2C_31_aout_1823_%28cropped%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Prise_du_Trocad%C3%A9ro_par_le_duc_d'Angoul%C3%AAme,_31_aout_1823_(cropped).jpg)

[April 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_7 "April 7"): The "[Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis")", a French infantry force, begin an attack on Spain that lasts until November.

*   [April 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_7 "April 7") – French forces, the "[Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis")", cross the Spanish border at the [Bidasoa River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bidasoa_River "Bidasoa River").
*   [April 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_10 "April 10") – [Siege of Pamplona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Pamplona_(1823) "Siege of Pamplona (1823)") begins in [Navarre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navarre "Navarre") as French troops besiege the city's garrison.
*   [April 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_13 "April 13") – [Franz Liszt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franz_Liszt "Franz Liszt"), 11, gives a concert in Vienna, after which he is personally congratulated by [Ludwig van Beethoven](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ludwig_van_Beethoven "Ludwig van Beethoven").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-3)
*   [May 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_5 "May 5") – Emperor [Pedro I of Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_I_of_Brazil "Pedro I of Brazil") inaugurates [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil "Brazil")'s first _Assembleia Geral_, with 50 Senators and 102 Deputies.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-4)
*   [May 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_7 "May 7") – [Mikhail Semyonovich Vorontsov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikhail_Semyonovich_Vorontsov "Mikhail Semyonovich Vorontsov") is appointed as [Governor-General](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor-General "Governor-General") of [Novorossiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Novorossiya "Novorossiya") (New Russia), the portion of [Russian Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_Empire "Russian Empire") bordering the Black Sea (in modern days it constitutes southern regions of [Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine")).[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-5)
*   [May 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_9 "May 9") – Russian author [Alexander Pushkin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_Pushkin "Alexander Pushkin") begins work on his verse novel _[Eugene Onegin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugene\_Onegin "Eugene Onegin")_.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-6)
*   [May 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_23 "May 23")
    *   The [rebel Spanish government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trienio_Liberal "Trienio Liberal") withdraws from [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid") to [Seville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seville "Seville") following the French advance.

*   [May 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_25 "May 25")
    *   The [Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), commander of the invading French forces, establishes a regency in [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid") on behalf of [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII "Ferdinand VII") who remains a captive of the Spanish government.
    *   The [Catholic Association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_Association "Catholic Association"), a campaign for [Catholic emancipation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_emancipation "Catholic emancipation") within the United Kingdom, begins in Ireland at a meeting of 13 people at a bookseller's house on [Capel Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capel_Street "Capel Street") in [Dublin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dublin "Dublin").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-7)

*   [June 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_5 "June 5") – [Raffles Institution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raffles_Institution "Raffles Institution") is established (as the Singapore Institution) by the founder of [Singapore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore "Singapore"), Sir [Stamford Raffles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stamford_Raffles "Stamford Raffles").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-8)
*   [June 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_23 "June 23") – Peruvian president [José de la Riva Agüero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_de_la_Riva_Ag%C3%BCero "José de la Riva Agüero") is [impeached](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impeachment "Impeachment") by Congress. He rebels and establishes a short-lived rival government in [Trujillo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trujillo,_Peru "Trujillo, Peru").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-9)

### July–September

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1823&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: July–September")]

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/50/Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg/250px-Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Plate_2_Retreat_of_Lt_Brady.jpg)

[August 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_18 "August 18"): The [Demerara rebellion of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara_rebellion_of_1823 "Demerara rebellion of 1823") is started by 10,000 black slaves in British Guiana.

*   [July 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_1 "July 1") – The [Congress of Central America](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Republic_of_Central_America "Federal Republic of Central America") declares absolute independence from Spain, Mexico and any other foreign nation, including North America, and a republican system of government is established.
*   [July 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_4 "July 4") – [Royal assent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_assent "Royal assent") is given to several significant [Acts of Parliament in the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acts_of_Parliament_in_the_United_Kingdom "Acts of Parliament in the United Kingdom"), after the [Home Secretary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Home_Secretary "Home Secretary") (and future Prime Minister) [Robert Peel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Peel "Robert Peel") had worked to get approval by Parliament. Approved are the [Judgment of Death Act 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judgment_of_Death_Act_1823 "Judgment of Death Act 1823"), effectively abolishing the [death penalty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_penalty "Death penalty") for over 100 offences and;[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10) allowing judges to commute sentences for capital offences (other than murder or treason) to imprisonment or [transportation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penal_transportation "Penal transportation").;[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-11) the Transportation Act allowing convicts transported to the colonies to be employed on public works.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10) On July 10, the [Gaols Act 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaols_Act_1823 "Gaols Act 1823") is given assent, beginning the process of prison reform based on the campaign of [Elizabeth Fry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_Fry "Elizabeth Fry").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10)
*   [July 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_15 "July 15") – The [Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basilica_of_Saint_Paul_Outside_the_Walls "Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls") in Rome is almost completely destroyed by fire.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Fires-12)
*   [July 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_16 "July 16") – [José Bernardo de Tagle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_Bernardo_de_Tagle_y_Portocarrero,_4th_Marquess_of_Torre_Tagle "José Bernardo de Tagle y Portocarrero, 4th Marquess of Torre Tagle") elected as the second [president of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Peru "President of Peru") by the Peruvian Congress.
*   [July 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_28 "July 28") – The first theatrical adaptation of the _[Frankenstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankenstein "Frankenstein")_ story, _[Presumption; or, the Fate of Frankenstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presumption;\_or,\_the\_Fate\_of\_Frankenstein "Presumption; or, the Fate of Frankenstein")_, opens at the [Royal Opera House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Opera_House "Royal Opera House"), [Covent Garden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Covent_Garden "Covent Garden") in London. On August 29, [Mary Shelley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Shelley "Mary Shelley") attends a performance, the only version of her novel she will ever see.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-13)
*   [August 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_1 "August 1") – [William Pitt Amherst](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Amherst,_1st_Earl_Amherst "William Amherst, 1st Earl Amherst") arrives in [Calcutta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calcutta "Calcutta") with Lady Amherst to become the new [Governor-General of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor-General_of_India "Governor-General of India").[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-14)
*   [August 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_4 "August 4") – [Felipe Enrique Neri, Baron de Bastrop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Felipe_Enrique_Neri,_Baron_de_Bastrop "Felipe Enrique Neri, Baron de Bastrop"), the Mexican government administrator in charge of Anglo-American immigration into Mexico's state of [Coahuila y Tejas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coahuila_y_Tejas "Coahuila y Tejas"), allows [Stephen F. Austin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_F._Austin "Stephen F. Austin") to put together an 11-man police force, that will later be expanded to become the [Texas Ranger Division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas_Ranger_Division "Texas Ranger Division").[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-15)
*   [August 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_5 "August 5") – The [Royal Hibernian Academy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Hibernian_Academy "Royal Hibernian Academy") is founded in [Dublin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dublin "Dublin").[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-16)
*   [August 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_16 "August 16") – Tsar [Alexander I of Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_I_of_Russia "Alexander I of Russia") draws up a secret "manifesto", designating his second younger brother [Nikolai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicholas_I_of_Russia "Nicholas I of Russia") to succeed him, bypassing Nikolai's older brother, [Grand Duke Konstantin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Duke_Konstantin_Pavlovich_of_Russia "Grand Duke Konstantin Pavlovich of Russia"). The existence of the manifesto is revealed on Alexander's death in 1825.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-17)
*   [August 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_18 "August 18") – [Demerara rebellion of 1823](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara_rebellion_of_1823 "Demerara rebellion of 1823"): In the British colony of [Demerara-Essequibo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demerara-Essequibo "Demerara-Essequibo") (modern-day Guyana in South America), an insurrection of 10,000 black slaves begins; it is suppressed after three days, but hundreds of suspects are executed in the reprisals that follow.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-18)
*   [August 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_20 "August 20") – [Pope Pius VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Pius_VII "Pope Pius VII") dies after a reign of more than 23 years that began on March 14, 1800; he is remembered for crowning [Napoleon Bonaparte](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napoleon_Bonaparte "Napoleon Bonaparte") as [Emperor of France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_of_France "Emperor of France").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Coulombe-19)
*   [August 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_24 "August 24") – [Hugh Glass](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugh_Glass "Hugh Glass") gets mauled by a sow grizzly while on a fur trapping expedition in the Missouri Territory and has to crawl 200 miles for help.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-20)
*   [August 31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_31 "August 31") – [Battle of Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero "Battle of Trocadero"): French infantry of the "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis" capture the fort of Trocadero and turn its guns on [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz").
*   [September 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_10 "September 10") – [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar") is named [dictator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dictator "Dictator") of [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru "Peru").
*   [September 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_17 "September 17") – [Pamplona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pamplona "Pamplona") surrenders to French forces after a five-month siege.
*   [September 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_22 "September 22") – [Joseph Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Smith "Joseph Smith") first goes to the place near [Manchester, New York](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchester,_New_York "Manchester, New York"), where the [golden plates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_plates "Golden plates") are stored, having been directed there by God through an angel (according to what he writes in 1838).
*   [September 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_23 "September 23") – [First Anglo-Burmese War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Anglo-Burmese_War "First Anglo-Burmese War"): [Burmese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burma "Burma") forces attack the British on Shapura, an island close to [Chittagong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chittagong "Chittagong").
*   [September 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_28 "September 28") – Roman Catholic Cardinal Annibale della Genga is elected [Pope Leo XII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Leo_XII "Pope Leo XII").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-Coulombe-19)
*   [September 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_30 "September 30") – [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz") surrenders to the French and [Ferdinand VII of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII_of_Spain "Ferdinand VII of Spain") is restored to his throne, immediately repealing the liberal [Spanish Constitution of 1812](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Constitution_of_1812 "Spanish Constitution of 1812"). Despite French advice, he begins an era of repression against his opponents known as the [Ominous Decade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ominous_Decade "Ominous Decade").

[December 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_2 "December 2"): The [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") is introduced by U.S. President [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe").

*   [October 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_5 "October 5") – _[The Lancet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Lancet "The Lancet")_ medical journal is founded by [Thomas Wakley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Wakley "Thomas Wakley") in London.
*   [October 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_22 "October 22") – [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar") writes to Paraguayan dictator [José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_Gaspar_Rodr%C3%ADguez_de_Francia "José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia") to release his friend the explorer [Aimé Bonpland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aim%C3%A9_Bonpland "Aimé Bonpland") under threat of invasion. Rodríguez never responds to the letter.
*   [November 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_3 "November 3") – An explosion at the Rainton Colliery Company's Plain Pit mine at [Chilton Moor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilton_Moor "Chilton Moor") in the north-east of England, kills at least 57 coal miners.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-21)
*   [November 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_7 "November 7") – General [Rafael del Riego](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_del_Riego "Rafael del Riego") is executed in Madrid for [high treason](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_treason "High treason").
*   [November 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_12 "November 12") – The first [Constitution of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution_of_Peru_(1823) "Constitution of Peru (1823)") is proclaimed, albeit it is almost immediately annulled by [Simón Bolívar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar").
*   [November](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November "November") – According to tradition, [William Webb Ellis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Webb_Ellis "William Webb Ellis") invents the sport of [rugby football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rugby_football "Rugby football") at [Rugby School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rugby_School "Rugby School") in England.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1823#cite_note-CBH-10)
*   [December 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_2 "December 2") – [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe") first introduces the [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") in the [State of the Union address](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_of_the_Union_address "State of the Union address"), declaring that any European attempts to recolonize the Americas would be considered a hostile act towards the United States.

The **Battle of Trocadero**, fought on 31 August 1823, was a significant battle in France's [expedition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis") in support of the Spanish King [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII "Ferdinand VII"). The French defeated the Spanish liberal forces and restored Ferdinand to absolute rule.

## Prelude

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Prelude")]

After the downfall of [Napoleon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napoleon "Napoleon"), King Ferdinand VII of Spain refused to adopt the liberal [Spanish Constitution of 1812](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Constitution_of_1812 "Spanish Constitution of 1812") and in 1820 faced a rebellion in favour of a [constitutional monarchy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitutional_monarchy "Constitutional monarchy"), led by [Rafael del Riego y Nuñez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_del_Riego_y_Nu%C3%B1ez "Rafael del Riego y Nuñez"). On March 10, 1820, in the Plaza de San Juan de Dios in [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz"), Royalist absolutist troops carried out a massacre against those of the population of Cádiz who supported the liberals and were celebrating the proclamation of the Constitution of 1812.

The King was captured and detained at Cádiz. Alarmed by these events, the other [European powers convened](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concert_of_Europe "Concert of Europe") in October 1822 at the [Congress of Verona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congress_of_Verona "Congress of Verona") and authorized France to intervene in the conflict and restore the rule of Ferdinand, with only [Britain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom_of_Great_Britain_and_Ireland "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland") abstaining from that decision.

## Military intervention

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Military intervention")]

[![Image 11](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/95/Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_%28128592667%29.jpg/250px-Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_%28128592667%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_(128592667).jpg)

Location of Trocadero in the Bay of Cádiz (1890)

On 17 April 1823, French forces led by [Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis-Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), son of the future [Charles X](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_X_of_France "Charles X of France"), crossed the [Pyrenees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyrenees "Pyrenees") into Spain.

The French forces were welcomed by the [Basques](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basques "Basques") and conservative Spaniards. The Duke dispatched a force to besiege [San Sebastián](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Sebasti%C3%A1n "San Sebastián") while he launched an attack on [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid"), held by the rebel government, which on 23 May withdrew to [Seville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seville "Seville"). Madrid's military commander secretly surrendered and fled to France, and the leaderless Madrid garrison could not keep out the French, who seized the city and installed a [regent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_de_Alc%C3%A1ntara_%C3%81lvarez_de_Toledo,_13th_Duke_of_the_Infantado "Pedro de Alcántara Álvarez de Toledo, 13th Duke of the Infantado"), pending Ferdinand's expected return.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero#cite_note-2)

The French moved south to deal with the rebels at Cádiz, and besieged the fort of [Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isla_del_Trocadero "Isla del Trocadero"), which controlled access to the city. On 31 August 1823 they launched a surprise bayonet attack from the sea side, taking advantage of the low tide, and took the fort. After this action, French infantry captured the Trocadero village by a flank attack. After this last action, 1700 Spanish soldiers were captured by the French.

Cádiz itself held out for three weeks despite bombardments, but was forced to surrender on 23 September 1823 and King Ferdinand was released and handed over to the French. Despite a prior promise of amnesty, the King ordered reprisals against the rebels; in the following years, an estimated 30,000 people were executed and 20,000 imprisoned.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

## Aftermath

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Aftermath")]

[![Image 12](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero%3B_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg/250px-Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero%3B_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero;_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg)

_[The Duke of Angoulême at the Taking of Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Duke\_of\_Angoul%C3%AAme\_at\_the\_Taking\_of\_Trocadero "The Duke of Angoulême at the Taking of Trocadero")_ by [Paul Delaroche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Delaroche "Paul Delaroche"), 1828

The Battle of Trocadero was one of the events that prompted U.S. President [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe") to proclaim what would become known as the [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") on 2 December 1823, to safeguard the [Americas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Americas "Americas") against intervention by European powers.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero#cite_note-3)

The fall of Trocadero was commemorated in Paris, with the [Trocadéro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trocad%C3%A9ro,_Paris "Trocadéro, Paris"), where the city was expanding to the edges of the [Bois de Boulogne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bois_de_Boulogne "Bois de Boulogne"). [Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis-Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), the victor of the battle, was offered the title "Prince of Trocadero" by the Spanish king, but he refused to accept it, partly in disgust at Ferdinand going back on his promises of clemency.

In _[Les Misérables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Les\_Mis%C3%A9rables "Les Misérables")_, [Victor Hugo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Victor_Hugo "Victor Hugo") devoted several paragraphs to the battle (Volume II, Book 2, chapter 3), in which he called the battle "a fine military action", but also said that "[t]he war of 1823 was an outrage on the generous Spanish nation, (..) at the same time, an outrage on the French Revolution."

The **Battle of Trocadero**, fought on 31 August 1823, was a significant battle in France's [expedition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Thousand_Sons_of_Saint_Louis "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis") in support of the Spanish King [Ferdinand VII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_VII "Ferdinand VII"). The French defeated the Spanish liberal forces and restored Ferdinand to absolute rule.

## Prelude

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Prelude")]

After the downfall of [Napoleon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napoleon "Napoleon"), King Ferdinand VII of Spain refused to adopt the liberal [Spanish Constitution of 1812](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Constitution_of_1812 "Spanish Constitution of 1812") and in 1820 faced a rebellion in favour of a [constitutional monarchy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitutional_monarchy "Constitutional monarchy"), led by [Rafael del Riego y Nuñez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_del_Riego_y_Nu%C3%B1ez "Rafael del Riego y Nuñez"). On March 10, 1820, in the Plaza de San Juan de Dios in [Cádiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1diz "Cádiz"), Royalist absolutist troops carried out a massacre against those of the population of Cádiz who supported the liberals and were celebrating the proclamation of the Constitution of 1812.

The King was captured and detained at Cádiz. Alarmed by these events, the other [European powers convened](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concert_of_Europe "Concert of Europe") in October 1822 at the [Congress of Verona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congress_of_Verona "Congress of Verona") and authorized France to intervene in the conflict and restore the rule of Ferdinand, with only [Britain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom_of_Great_Britain_and_Ireland "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland") abstaining from that decision.

## Military intervention

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Military intervention")]

[![Image 11](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/95/Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_%28128592667%29.jpg/250px-Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_%28128592667%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Cadiz_MKL_Bd._3_1890_(128592667).jpg)

Location of Trocadero in the Bay of Cádiz (1890)

On 17 April 1823, French forces led by [Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis-Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), son of the future [Charles X](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_X_of_France "Charles X of France"), crossed the [Pyrenees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyrenees "Pyrenees") into Spain.

The French forces were welcomed by the [Basques](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basques "Basques") and conservative Spaniards. The Duke dispatched a force to besiege [San Sebastián](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Sebasti%C3%A1n "San Sebastián") while he launched an attack on [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid"), held by the rebel government, which on 23 May withdrew to [Seville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seville "Seville"). Madrid's military commander secretly surrendered and fled to France, and the leaderless Madrid garrison could not keep out the French, who seized the city and installed a [regent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_de_Alc%C3%A1ntara_%C3%81lvarez_de_Toledo,_13th_Duke_of_the_Infantado "Pedro de Alcántara Álvarez de Toledo, 13th Duke of the Infantado"), pending Ferdinand's expected return.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero#cite_note-2)

The French moved south to deal with the rebels at Cádiz, and besieged the fort of [Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isla_del_Trocadero "Isla del Trocadero"), which controlled access to the city. On 31 August 1823 they launched a surprise bayonet attack from the sea side, taking advantage of the low tide, and took the fort. After this action, French infantry captured the Trocadero village by a flank attack. After this last action, 1700 Spanish soldiers were captured by the French.

Cádiz itself held out for three weeks despite bombardments, but was forced to surrender on 23 September 1823 and King Ferdinand was released and handed over to the French. Despite a prior promise of amnesty, the King ordered reprisals against the rebels; in the following years, an estimated 30,000 people were executed and 20,000 imprisoned.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

## Aftermath

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Battle_of_Trocadero&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Aftermath")]

[![Image 12](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero%3B_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg/250px-Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero%3B_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Duque_de_Angulema_en_el_Trocadero;_Hippolyte_Delaroche.jpg)

_[The Duke of Angoulême at the Taking of Trocadero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Duke\_of\_Angoul%C3%AAme\_at\_the\_Taking\_of\_Trocadero "The Duke of Angoulême at the Taking of Trocadero")_ by [Paul Delaroche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Delaroche "Paul Delaroche"), 1828

The Battle of Trocadero was one of the events that prompted U.S. President [James Monroe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Monroe "James Monroe") to proclaim what would become known as the [Monroe Doctrine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monroe_Doctrine "Monroe Doctrine") on 2 December 1823, to safeguard the [Americas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Americas "Americas") against intervention by European powers.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Trocadero#cite_note-3)

The fall of Trocadero was commemorated in Paris, with the [Trocadéro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trocad%C3%A9ro,_Paris "Trocadéro, Paris"), where the city was expanding to the edges of the [Bois de Boulogne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bois_de_Boulogne "Bois de Boulogne"). [Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis-Antoine,_Duke_of_Angoul%C3%AAme "Louis-Antoine, Duke of Angoulême"), the victor of the battle, was offered the title "Prince of Trocadero" by the Spanish king, but he refused to accept it, partly in disgust at Ferdinand going back on his promises of clemency.

In _[Les Misérables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Les\_Mis%C3%A9rables "Les Misérables")_, [Victor Hugo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Victor_Hugo "Victor Hugo") devoted several paragraphs to the battle (Volume II, Book 2, chapter 3), in which he called the battle "a fine military action", but also said that "[t]he war of 1823 was an outrage on the generous Spanish nation, (..) at the same time, an outrage on the French Revolution."
